title: MoE-Lightning: High-Throughput MoE Inference on Memory-constrained GPUs
problem: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs have very large total parameter counts that exceed the VRAM of commodity GPUs, forcing weight offloading to CPU memory or NVMe, which creates severe I/O bottlenecks and low GPU utilization during batch inference.
motivation: MoE models offer high capacity at low per-token compute cost, making them attractive for efficient LLM inference, but their large memory footprint makes them inaccessible to users with low-end or single GPUs without efficient offloading strategies.
method: MoE-Lightning pipelines expert weights between CPU and GPU memory: while the GPU computes with current weights, the system simultaneously prefetches the next weights from CPU, reducing GPU idle time. It stores these weights in fixed-size pages and uses a Hierarchical Roofline Model (a performance model that predicts throughput based on batch size, GPU memory, CPU memory, and I/O bandwidth) to automatically select optimal settings. The system scales to multi-GPU configurations for larger models like Mixtral 8x22B and DBRX on 2-4 T4 GPUs.
key_novelty: CGOPipe pipelines expert weights between CPU and GPU, guided by a Hierarchical Roofline Model that predicts throughput, enabling efficient large-model inference on memory-limited GPUs.
contributions: CGOPipe: CPU-GPU-I/O pipeline with paged weight management for high-throughput MoE inference under VRAM constraints
HRM (Hierarchical Roofline Model): a performance model for identifying high-throughput offloading policies
Up to 10.3x throughput improvement over state-of-the-art offloading-enabled LLM inference for Mixtral 8x7B on a single T4 GPU (16GB)
2-3x reduction in CPU memory consumption at system throughput upper bound; support for Mixtral 8x22B and DBRX on 2-4 T4 GPUs

metrics.speedup: 10.3x throughput over state-of-the-art offloading-enabled LLM inference (Mixtral 8x7B on single T4 16GB GPU)
metrics.other: 2-3x less CPU memory at throughput upper bound

limitations: Evaluated on low-end T4 GPUs; performance characteristics on high-end GPUs (A100, H100) where VRAM is less constrained are not the primary focus.
primary_theme: CPU-GPU-IO pipeline for high-throughput MoE inference on memory-constrained GPUs
